honesty: the specimen coreboot.rom is UNCHANGED from ring 24/25 (SeaBIOS payload, no rebuild)
the kernel self-qualifies its firmware mode — the chain tells us which firmware booted it
the UKI-on-disk OVMF path (hand-built objcopy UKI) loads and STARTS (BdsDxe) but stays silent after — open thread, next session

debug history kept in the factory scripts: syslinux 6.04 rejects dosfstools-4.2 FAT behind a hand-written partition; GRUB 2.12 says "unknown filesystem" for the same; mtools superfloppy at LBA 0 mounts fine on both worlds — the failure class is "hand-written MBR partition", worked around, not solved
